cases.sentence: Павел по своему обычаю пошел в ___.
cases.translation: Paul, as was his custom, went into the synagogue.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with accusative case indicates motion into a place.

cases.translation: This aroused the jealousy of the other Jews.
cases.explain: After the quantifier 'остальных' (the others), the genitive plural is used.

cases.translation: He reasoned with the Jews about the Scripture.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: собрали ___ и устроили в городе беспорядки.
cases.translation: They gathered a crowd and created a disturbance in the city.
cases.explain: Толпу is the direct object of the verb собрали (gathered), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они ринулись к дому Иосона в ___.
cases.translation: They rushed to Jason's house in the city.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with prepositional case indicates location.

cases.translation: The Bereans received the word with great interest.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: его возмущало огромное количество ___ в этом городе.
cases.translation: He was distressed by the great number of idols in this city.
cases.explain: After 'количество' (quantity), the genitive plural is used.

cases.sentence: На одном из жертвенников было написано «Неизвестному ___».
cases.translation: On one of the altars was written 'TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.'
cases.explain: The preposition to (implied before 'unknown') requires the dative case.

reading.ru: Павел по своему обычаю пошел в синагогу, и там три субботы подряд рассуждал с иудеями о Писании.
reading.question: How many times did Paul go to the synagogue to reason with the Jews?
reading.explain: The text says 'три субботы подряд' — three Sabbath days in a row.

reading.ru: Им удалось убедить как нескольких иудеев, так и многих благочестивых греков и немало знатных женщин.
reading.question: Who were the people Paul and Silas convinced in Thessalonica?
options: Some Jews, many devout Greeks, and not a few prominent women
reading.correct: Some Jews, many devout Greeks, and not a few prominent women
reading.explain: The sentence lists those who were persuaded: иудеев, греков, and женщин.

reading.ru: Верийцы были людьми более открытыми, чем фессалоникийцы.
reading.question: How did the Bereans compare to the Thessalonians in terms of openness?
reading.explain: The text states: 'Верийцы были людьми более открытыми' — the Bereans were more open-minded people.

reading.ru: Павел в ожидании своих спутников ходил по Афинам, и его возмущало огромное количество идолов в этом городе.
reading.question: Why was Paul distressed while waiting for his companions in Athens?
options: He was troubled by the great number of idols in the city
reading.correct: He was troubled by the great number of idols in the city
reading.explain: The text says 'его возмущало огромное количество идолов' — the multitude of idols distressed him.

reading.ru: На одном из жертвенников было написано «Неизвестному Богу».
reading.question: What was written on one of the altars that Paul saw?
reading.explain: The text specifies the inscription: 'Неизвестному Богу' — To an Unknown God.

reading.ru: Когда они услышали о воскресении из мертвых, то некоторые из них начали посмеиваться, другие же сказали, «Об этом мы послушаем тебя в другой раз».
reading.question: What were the two different reactions to Paul's message about the resurrection?
options: Some mocked, while others asked to hear more later
reading.correct: Some mocked, while others asked to hear more later
reading.explain: The passage describes both reactions: некоторые посмеиваются (some mocked) and другие (others said they would listen).
